title: Non-Archimedean Poincaré series and geodesics on the Bruhat-Tits tree
summary: Adapting a construction of Kurihara in the setting of Drinfeld modular forms, we define Poincaré series on the Drinfeld half-plane $Ω$. These series are built from products of meromorphic $1$-forms that are naturally associated to geodesics on the Bruhat-Tits tree. We establish convergence under a finiteness condition on the geodesics, verify this condition in several cases, and give sufficient conditions for the resulting cusp forms to be nonzero.
